calc_iou: compute IoU of two axis-aligned 3D bounding boxes given center coordinates and dimensions
test_calc_iou: test calc_iou with overlapping and non-overlapping 3D bounding boxes
build_single_scene_precision_recall: build precision and recall for predicted 3D bounding boxes against ground-truth boxes in a single scene
build_multi_scene_precision_recall: build batched precision and recall across multiple scenes with optional label and prediction masks
summarize_precision_recall: summarize precision and recall computation from true positive, false positive, and false negative counts
